info.title: JsxCore.Npm: npm packages without npm
info.description: Adds and restores npm packages from the command line with nothing installed but the .NET SDK. Resolves versions, verifies integrity, writes node_modules and a package-lock.json that real npm accepts. Ships the same client the JsxCore build uses.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Version range to add, as ^12 or 12.0.1. Defaults to the latest
release. A range on the name, as marked@^12, works too.

options.name: --dev
options.description: Add to devDependencies rather than dependencies.

options.name: --project
options.description:
Project or directory whose package.json to use. Defaults to the
current directory.

options.name: --registry
options.description:
Registry to resolve from. Defaults to registry.npmjs.org.
npm's own spellings work too: install, i, ls, rm and un.
Packages in dependencies are served to the browser; packages in devDependencies are
build and server only. See https://github.com/davidwhitney/JsxCore for the rest.
